added.name: Agent 37
added.long_description:
* Ready to Use Instantly: Skip the complex server setup. It comes pre loaded with top AI Agents (like Claude Code and Hermes) so your agents can start working immediately.

* Keep Your Work Safe: Unlike other systems that delete everything when they finish a task, these sandboxes remember your files, code, and settings forever until you delete them.

* Pay Only for What You Use: Stop paying for idle servers. You pay a tiny fee to store your files, but you only pay for compute power during the exact minutes your AI is actively running.

* Zero Infrastructure Headaches: You don’t need to be a senior DevOps engineer or manage complex cloud networks. One simple command handles the entire backend for you.

* Connect to Any App: Allow your AI agents to securely log into and interact with everyday tools like Slack, Gmail, and GitHub in just a few clicks.
added.one_liner: Persistent sandboxes for agents like hermes, openclaw, claude code

added.name: Aviern
added.long_description: Aviern builds unmanned airplanes that turn the sky into a geospatial intelligence source. Our fixed-wing aircraft launch, fly, and land from unattended docks along infrastructure corridors, with onboard perception that flags leaks, encroachments, and vegetation risk with no pilot in the loop. We're starting with PHMSA-mandated pipeline patrol, where operators still pay helicopter crews to fly their lines up to 26 times a year, and we sell per mile as a service. The same aircraft, docks, and intelligence stack extend to the power grid, rail, borders, and bases.

added.name: Ignition Benefits
added.long_description: Ignition is an AI-native employee benefits brokerage for companies with under 200 employees. Health insurance is one of the largest line items these companies carry, and employers absorb 15 to 40% rate increases year after year without ever seeing their own numbers. We have rebuilt the sales and back office to be AI-first. This market represents about $500B of market cap, and those businesses have not fundamentally changed in over 50 years. While scaling Plated, I wore every HR hat from doing payroll myself, to managing a PEO, to eventually hiring an employee benefits broker on our way to 1,500 employees. We wasted over $4M on benefits over 5 years, and I'm building Ignition to help companies under 200 employees avoid making my mistakes.

added.name: Papaya
added.long_description:
Papaya is the optimization engine for AI agents. Engineers don't have time to continually improve the agents they've shipped — the context bloat, overly chatty subagents, and broken tool calls sit in production traces nobody reads, quietly hurting agent efficiency. With Papaya they connect their agent directly via SDK, get actionable recommendations on how to improve quality, latency, and cost, and the ones they approve are pushed to production as pull requests.

Papaya runs 200+ research-backed analyses across context, prompts, prompt caching, subagents, and tool calls. Every recommendation is ranked by impact and comes with the production runs that produced it — typically a 10%+ quality improvement on the first workflow analysis.

Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.

The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.

Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.

Built locally. Designed to scale globally.

long_description.before: RiskCube provides insurance for startups in AI, robotics, space & defense tech. When you're days from closing an enterprise or gov contract and procurement asks for a Certificate of Insurance (COI), a traditional broker can take weeks — and the deal stalls. RiskCube fixes that: we compare 40+ AM Best-rated U.S. carriers, pair that with licensed human broker review, and bind the right coverage and issue your COI within a day, not weeks. Founders get D&O, Tech E&O, Cyber, General Liability, Product Liability, Key Person Life, and COIs — to pass procurement, satisfy investors, and close deals. RiskCube is an independent broker, not an insurance carrier, built for AI, Space and Defense, and government-contractor startups. Licensed in CA, TX, and DE (expanding nationwide).
long_description.after:
RiskCube is building the first AI-native reinsurer for emerging risks.

Today, we operate an insurance brokerage focused on startups in AI, robotics, space, and defense. Through the brokerage, we see firsthand where traditional insurance products fail, from AI liability and autonomous systems to defense technology and new space risks.

We are now building proprietary risk models that can price risks even when little historical claims data exists. Our approach uses stochastic simulation, then applies traditional, explainable models to make the output transparent to underwriters and regulators.

This allows us to create new insurance and reinsurance products for emerging industries much faster than traditional carriers.

The U.S. insurance market still relies heavily on foreign reinsurance capacity.
Our goal is to build new reinsurance capacity on American soil for the industries defining the next generation of the U.S. economy, while reducing America's dependence on foreign reinsurance capacity.

one_liner.after: America’s first reinsurer for emerging risks.

long_description.before:
You built the demo in a weekend. Now you need auth, a prod-grade database, real-time events, AI observability, cron jobs, email, monitoring… and you needed them yesterday.

We spent a decade at our previous startup, building a $500M platform while scaling to millions of users and customers like Meta & Netflix. Now we're standardizing how web applications are built with an open-source framework and AI App Builder, so non developers can build reliable production apps and not just prototypes.

Modelence is a batteries-included platform with a dedicated web app framework that's designed for building production grade apps with AI, abstracting away the standard building blocks:
- Authentication
- Database
- Hosting
- AI integration
- Cron jobs
- Live / real-time data
- Email integration
- Monitoring

Most AI app builders just stitch together multiple services and existing frameworks. The reliability drops hard because integrations between different parts break. Modelence defines a single full-stack framework with dedicated cloud infrastructure, where these integrations are already built into the framework and don't need to be built for every app.
long_description.after:
You built your product in a weekend and deployed to Vercel, Supabase, Railway or AWS. Now you need to figure out how to pick the right region, scale to multiple instances, add monitoring and alerts, and who to ping when something breaks… and you don't have a cloud engineer.

We spent a decade at our previous startup (CodeSignal), building a $500M platform while scaling to millions of users and customers like Meta & Netflix. Now we're standardizing how web applications are operated in production, so developers can build reliable production apps without becoming cloud infrastructure experts.

Modelence is a production cloud that's designed for enterprise-grade apps, abstracting away the infrastructure layer:
- Deployments & hosting
- Background jobs and persistence
- File storage, real-time data and networking
- Monitoring and alerts

Platforms like Vercel and Supabase are easy to start with, but most companies that start getting real customers eventually need a persistent backend where processes can run beyond just a few minutes at a time, unlike pure serverless. And low-level cloud platforms like AWS are meant to be operated by cloud engineers and are too complicated for engineers who want to focus on product rather than infra. Modelence is your managed backend infrastructure, built on decades of our experience operating web apps in the cloud.

long_description.before:
Micora is a next-generation robotic energy developer that compresses the timeline from initial design to power generation from years to weeks. Our vertically integrated platform combines purpose-built robotic hardware with proprietary modular energy systems, enabling critical power infrastructure to be designed, manufactured, and deployed at unprecedented speed.

Traditional energy projects are slow, costly, and built around processes that were never designed for today’s rapidly growing power demands. Micora is rebuilding energy development from the ground up; transforming what has historically been a bespoke, multi-year construction process into a repeatable and scalable manufacturing system.

As demand from data centers, advanced manufacturing, and electrification strains existing power infrastructure, the ability to deploy new generation quickly is becoming increasingly valuable. Micora is building the infrastructure platform needed to deliver power wherever and whenever it is needed.
long_description.after:
Micora builds a solar-farm-in-a-box that can be shipped anywhere and built without specialized labor. We have designed a new type of solar farm micorgrid that is palletized, lightweight, and deployable. Our system autonomously builds 100kWp of capacity per day and is easily scalable to MWs of capacity which is a size currently only serviced by slow moving and at capacity EPCs. 

As demand from data centers, advanced manufacturing, and electrification strains existing power infrastructure, the ability to deploy substantial generation quickly is becoming increasingly valuable and unavailable. We are the only company that services utility-scale power needs in weeks.
